high_level_description: The image shows a person taking a mirror selfie. The individual is wearing a light-colored, long-sleeved dress with a pattern that includes small golden dots and a checkered design on the lower part of the garment. They have dark hair that falls over their shoulders and are holding a smartphone with both hands to take the photo. The person is also wearing a white, beaded handbag with tassels hanging from it. The background features a red, quilted wall with multiple compartments, each containing keys.
